title: Nimble Crisp Kenyan Gruyere Salad
description: A buttery, mustardy salad that marries fresh spinach, roasted monsoon pumpkin, and melty Gruyere for a crisp, Kenyan-inspired lunch.
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a rolling boil, add 200ml vegetable broth, and blanch the spinach for 1 minute, then plunge into ice water to preserve color.
Drain spinach thoroughly and pat dry with a towel.
In a small bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard, olive oil, apple cider vinegar, honey, sea salt, pepper, and lemon zest to make a dressing.
Toss the blanched spinach with the dressing until evenly coated.
Spread the dressed spinach on a large baking sheet, sprinkle with shredded Gruyere, and bake at 180°C for 5 minutes until cheese is melted and lightly golden.
Roast 150g pumpkin cubes in a separate pan with a drizzle of olive oil at 200°C for 15 minutes until tender and slightly caramelized.
Combine the baked spinach, roasted pumpkin cubes, and toasted pumpkin seeds in a serving bowl.
Drizzle any remaining melted cheese over the salad and garnish with extra pumpkin seeds.
Serve immediately and enjoy the crisp, mustardy flavor.
